notes: Eval 1 (judge range defects) is non-discriminating: both configs scored 8/8 because the date maths is solvable from the prompt alone. The skill's value there is in naming (WL-D-02/03), re-verification steps with the browser helper, and noticing the WL-D-02 test only checks to_date.

The big gains are portal knowledge: real data-zpqa locators, the user-views / custom-workload endpoints, fav/unfav classes and the rc-checked trap. The baseline invented selectors and placeholder endpoints in evals 0 and 2.
Cost: with-skill runs used ~23% more tokens (+19.7k) and ~10 s more on average, mostly from reading references and the bundled project.

The with-skill permission plan found real gaps in the bundled permissions spec (minimal PUT body could fail for the wrong reason; G-05 compared flags of a different view than the menu it opened; Delete never checked; D-02 test checked only to_date). Fixed after this iteration: the API tests now replay the app's own captured save body (Admin replay must succeed first), the menu is opened on the seed view itself, the Delete menu item and is_deletable are checked, and from_date is asserted. Executing a delete is still pending a confirmed delete locator/endpoint.
Single run per configuration: variance figures reflect differences between evals, not run-to-run noise.
